actions.description: Create a cost code category within a budget
actions.name: create-budget-cost-code-category

actions.description: Create a cost code within a budget cost code category.
actions.name: create-budget-cost-code

budget_cost_code_category_id.description: ID of the budget cost code category. Example: "6a71df24f55241acad0cd518"

actions.name: create-building

owner_contact_id.description: ID of the owner contact. Example: "6a71ddac92e09607f906db64"

owner_company_id.description: ID of the owner company. Example: "6a71ddac92e09607f906db63"

id.description: ID of the created building. Example: "6a71dfc6f55241acad0cd599"

effective_date.description: Effective date in Y-m-d format. Example: "2026-08-04"

total_value.description: Total value for this line item. Example: "1000.00"

wbs1.description: WBS line items for the contract

contract_wbs1_id.description: WBS1 line item ID from the contract. Example: "6a71df4b92e09607f906dc09"

value.description: Invoice value for this WBS1 line item. Example: "100.00"

actions.description: Create a file record by providing a URL for the platform to download from.
actions.name: create-file

url.description: Publicly accessible URL to download the file from. Example: "https://example.com/document.pdf"

file_name.description: Optional file name for the file. Example: "document.pdf"

original_created_at.description: Optional original creation date of the file content, in UTC ISO 8601 format. Example: "2024-04-01T12:00:00Z"

id.description: The ID of the created file record.

actions.description: Create a new project
actions.name: create-project

name.description: Name of the project. Example: "Nango Registry Test Project"

base_currency.description: Base currency of the project in ISO3 format. Example: "USD"

status.description: Status of the project. If set to "External Pending", all otherwise-required fields become optional.

id.description: Global ID of the created project

actions.description: Create a new punch item on a project.
actions.name: create-punch-item

title.description: Title of the punch item. Example: "Nango Registry Test Punch Item"

status.description: Status of the punch item. Valid values: NOT_STARTED, IN_PROGRESS, UNDER_REVIEW, COMPLETED, ARCHIVED

due_date.description: Due date in ISO-8601 format with a literal Z suffix. Example: "2026-08-18T00:00:00Z"

id.description: ID of the created punch item. Example: "6a71dffe..."

actions.description: Add a proposed solution/answer to an RFI.
actions.name: create-rfi-solution

rfi_id.description: The RFI ID to which the solution belongs. Example: "6a71df9dcb6ddf6b370e0a6f"

text.description: The text content of the RFI solution.

is_official.description: Whether this solution is the official response.

cost_impact.description: Cost impact of the solution. One of: yes, no, tbd.

schedule_impact.description: Schedule impact of the solution. One of: yes, no, tbd.

cost_impact_value.description: Monetary value of the cost impact. Required when cost_impact is "yes".

schedule_impact_value.description: Number of days/weeks of schedule impact. Required when schedule_impact is "yes".

schedule_impact_type.description: Unit of the schedule impact value. One of: days, weeks, tbd. Required when schedule_impact_value is provided.

document_ids.description: Uploaded document IDs to attach to the solution.

actions.description: Create a new RFI on a project.
actions.name: create-rfi

project_id.description: The project ID to which the RFI belongs. Example: "6a71de59f55241acad0cd44e"

due_date.description: Due date of the RFI in Y-m-d format. Example: "2026-08-04"

status.description: Status of the RFI. Only "draft" has been confirmed valid live. Example: "draft"

question.description: The question or issue described in the RFI.

actions.description: Create a new submittal package for a project.

project_id.description: The project ID to which the submittal type belongs. Example: "6a71de59f55241acad0cd44e"

title.description: The title/name of the submittal type. Example: "Nango Registry Test Submittal Type"

is_required_for_material_release.description: Whether this submittal type is required for material release.

actions.description: Create a new submittal within a package.
actions.name: create-submittal

project_id.description: The project ID to which the submittal belongs. Example: "6a71de59f55241acad0cd44e"

package_id.description: The package ID to which the submittal belongs. Example: "6a71dfa2f55241acad0cd56a"

type_id.description: The submittal type ID defined in Project Settings. Example: "6a71df8992e09607f906dc20"

title.description: The title of the submittal. Example: "Nango Registry Test Submittal"

description.description: Additional information further describing the submittal.

final_approval_due_date.description: Date in Y-m-d format used to calculate schedule dates.

required_on_site_date.description: Date materials are required on-site. Y-m-d format.

material_lead_time.description: Amount of days/weeks for materials to arrive.

material_lead_time_unit.description: Unit of time for material lead time.

internal_review_time.description: Amount of days/weeks reviewers have to review.

internal_review_time_unit.description: Unit of time for internal review.

design_review_time.description: Amount of days/weeks official reviewers have to review.

design_review_time_unit.description: Unit of time for design review.

contractor_review_time.description: Amount of days/weeks documentation must be submitted by.

contractor_review_time_unit.description: Unit of time for contractor review.

submittal_manager_review_time.description: Amount of days/weeks reviewers have to review.

submittal_manager_review_time_unit.description: Unit of time for submittal manager review.

submittal_approval_review_time.description: Amount of days/weeks the Submittal Manager has to review.

submittal_approval_review_time_unit.description: Unit of time for submittal approval review.

responsible_contractor_id.description: The ID of the contractor responsible for this submittal.

impacted_party_ids.description: Array of person IDs that are impacted.

document_ids.description: Uploaded document IDs associated with the submittal.

external_id.description: The external ID of the submittal.

source_platform.description: The source platform from which the submittal is being created.

external_reference_url.description: The URL to the submittal in the source platform.
